_comment: Golden fixture for Burnice build reconstructed from this fixture's own stat_line (was DB build 019e7ade, Electro-Lip Gloss R1, M0, L60, 4pc Chaos Jazz + 2pc Freedom Blues). ZO repo 464e7a2 has only a README; no ZO UI capture was performed. All values formula-derived and independently verified. BUILD SOURCE CHANGED 2026-08-07: the DB build this named existed only in one developer's database and was never checked in, so this archetype skipped for everyone else and FAILED under CROSSVAL_REQUIRE_DB=1 — the mode a reviewer is told to run before merging a damage-chain change. The build is now reconstructed from `stat_line` + `active_modifiers` below, which is what every `formula` here already derives from; the golden values did not move.

active_modifiers._note: fire_dmg=1500 from Chaos Jazz 4pc (equipper_is_fire, resolved to always at snapshot). Electro-Lip Gloss passive (enemy_has_anomaly) is inactive in crossval conditions. AP=437: agent_base=120 + disc=182 (main+substats) + ELG_secondary@L60=75 + CJ_2pc=30 + FB_2pc=30 (the prior 435 used 118, which is Burnice's anomaly MASTERY — proficiency/mastery were transposed). ATK=2597 = ((agent L60 base 788 + core_stats[5].atk 75) + Electro-Lip Gloss 594) * 1.54 + 354 flat; the prior 2480 omitted the core flat ATK, which sits in the base bracket and is therefore scaled by ATK%. NO anomaly_dmg_bonus: the prior fixture applied 3000bp from a 'Core: Afterburn DMG (max, approx)' kit row that the Task 17 Batch 4 audit deleted as unsound on two counts — it hardcoded the AP-scaled '+1% Afterburn DMG per 10 Anomaly Proficiency, max 30%' at its cap, and Afterburn is a separate teammate-triggered Fire DMG instance, not the Burn anomaly ticks this fixture measures.

events.formula_notes: Burn MV=50%; fire_dmg boost=1500bp; DEF_area=498 (pen_flat=9 applied); AP_area=437*100=43700 (437=120_agent+182_disc+75_ELG_secondary+30_CJ2pc+30_FB2pc); anomaly_boost=10000 (none — see active_modifiers._note); no res_ignore (M6 inactive at M0)
